name: Rowan
title: Traveling merchant
introduction: A dusty wagon stops at the village. Rowan has grain to spare, but needs provisions for the road.

name: Lark
title: Wandering musician
introduction: Lark offers an evening of songs in exchange for a meal. A little company could lift everyone's spirits.
reward: +20 percentage points of Social for every current villager (up to full)

name: Mira
title: Prospective resident
introduction: Mira, a grower with a Green Thumb, is looking for a village to call home. Can you offer a spare bed?
reward: Mira joins with the Green Thumb trait; requires a vacant bed in completed, reachable housing
